verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK, so CPU instruction-set acceleration is a fair axis to judge. The evidence only names Qualcomm Hexagon NPU and Apple Metal acceleration, plus generic claims about using 'whatever silicon the device has' and validating kernels against the silicon. Nothing documents AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX or any x86 CPU optimization.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can leverage advanced x86 CPU instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
